description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing SelfServiceRegistration entities, providing methods for querying registration requests based on ID and authentication token.

classes.name: SelfServiceRegistrationRepository
classes.description: Repository interface extending JPA repository for SelfServiceRegistration entities, including a custom query method to retrieve a registration request by ID and authentication token.

methods.name: getRequestByIdAndAuthenticationToken
methods.description: Custom query method to fetch a SelfServiceRegistration entity matching the provided ID and authentication token.
